name: 6 PEOPLE
source:
A man travels in a subway car alone.
Where is he going?
Will he or any of his fellow passengers arrive at their destination?
Have they been drawn together by pure coincidence, or something more sinister?

Join the passengers and ride the subway to its end to witness the first mysterious event in this three part series from GsK.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258770/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一名男子独自乘坐地铁。
他要去哪里？
他，或是同行的其他乘客，能抵达各自的目的地吗？
把他们聚在一起的，究竟纯属巧合，还是某种更加险恶的力量？

加入这些乘客，搭乘地铁驶向终点，见证GsK三部曲中的第一起神秘事件。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258770/]Steam[/url]]
